_comment: The AI Reasoning Engine's prompt registry. **Owned here, not by the AI Platform** — a module owns its own artifacts, and the AI Platform's registry holds the AI Platform's own prompts (CLAUDE.md §2). `load_prompt_registry(directory)` is already per-directory, so no platform change was needed. `fingerprint` is the SHA-256 of name, version and text; the loader refuses to start if the file disagrees with it. A released version is never edited in place. `evaluations` is append-only and outside the fingerprint. A prompt is usable only with the exact (model, dataset) pairs it has passed (ADR-0028).
